inference_scope: Descriptive means. Shared authored items, related translations and fixedinitialization; no claim of independent biological replicates.

design.warmdown: lag fresh contexts/actions with no scheduled outcome
design.stream: one infer, schedule, deliver due, batch-1 learn before next action
design.shared_stream: context indices and sampling uniforms fixed per seed across all conditions
design.feedback: learner receives observation, sampled action, and actual +/-1 outcome only
design.bounded_storage: pending rows only; insertion enforces capacity delay+1 atomically; monotonic scalar rejects stale/duplicate IDs
design.limitation: Updates recompute gradients at current weights, so exact_tagged is software action-ID credit, not a biological neural trace. Original delayed-credit batched-rollout results are not a biological online delay curve.
design.selection: all settings predeclared; no result-based tuning

interpretation: At lag zero all three credit rules are identical and produced identical checkpoints and metrics.
At lag 16, wrong-current credit fell near chance while exact action-ID tagging retained its lag-zero test and Korean performance.
Decayed tagging retained accuracy but reduced mean correct probability; its constant exp(-2) reward scaling remains an amplitude confound rather than evidence for a special eligibility mechanism.
This online result replaces neither the preserved batched study nor a biological trace experiment; it isolates chronological software credit assignment under current-weight updates.

guard_rerun_verification.note: Raw file SHA changed on reserialization although metrics/counts were identical. Engine.save builds safetensors metadata from a Rust HashMap whose serialization order is process-randomized; current checkpoint hashes are recorded per run.
